scope: R11 safe_start and R12 follow_on only; separate from the eight-capture recovery aggregate.

audit.coordinate_system: Unity world XYZ, Y up; root rotations XYZW
limits: Client-rendered/replicated observations, not authoritative server contact state.
Limb positions are named bone origins, not collider surfaces or contact points.
Variable-QPC finite differences measure displacement; impacts, interpolation and position resets can all contribute.
Diagnostic speed-threshold intervals are motion, not identified attacks.
no_score_observed does not mean a missed or rejected attack; native active-clip/apex and contact-enter state are unavailable.
One-, two- and five-point updates describe counter increments only; batches and authoritative causes are not resolved.
Neutral commands do not hold the robot stationary or disable physical response.
Score/window comparisons stop at round, slot, clock, sequence and sampling-gap boundaries.
Requested action and measured command checks are sampled evidence, not proof of every intervening command.

media.capture_source: authentic REK framebuffer on isolated X11 :98

limits: These are client-native received effects/score packets and replicated poses, without authoritative impact time or collision causality.
All same-frame hit/score associations are noncausal. Hit packets identify no fighter, clip, strike side or body zone.
Five-point awards are retained as decoded awards only; no fall, knockout, push or strike cause is assigned.
The hit channel is unreliable, so absent receipts leave contact unknown.
Hit/score receipt clocks contain Unity frame/time and realtime receipt time, but no QPC, UTC or server impact time. Pose QPC stays separate.

R12 is a partial relay attachment. Its pre-attachment hit and score have no prior/same-frame relay pose. The next pose is a later observation, not a reconstructed event pose. Native root records exist separately and have not been substituted into this paired join.
Neutral action 1 releases held controls; it does not freeze physics. Sampled neutral state and method invocations do not prove every intervening state or server delivery.
R11 and R12 use no policy, encoder or checkpoint. Repeated hit receipt is established; exact known-action/position repeatability and causal attribution are not.
